params.body:
Restack of #356 (`workbench/feat/average-price-facet-counts`) on the one-file-per-finding layout. **Stacked on #370 (which is stacked on #368 and #369): merge those first, then this one.** The gateway pushes each PR as a snapshot of its own files on top of main, so this diff shows only this PR's files; it is green on the old guard test on its own and on the new one once #370 is in.

Same change as #356, with one difference: the four findings it added as X-127 to X-130 are files in `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/` (no number, named by slug), and the references in `AveragePriceSearchTest`, in the rule text of R S1-5.14 and in `VehicleRepository` point at them:

- `2026-09-15-biedingen-filteren-op-merk-en-model.md` (opgelost)
- `2026-09-15-verkoop-zonder-prijs-telt-als-nul.md` (open, deze week, Ilse)
- `2026-09-15-gemiddelde-prijs-telt-eigen-verkopen-mee.md` (open, later, Ilse)
- `2026-09-15-grenzen-open-voor-de-snede.md` (opgelost)

No rule number changed: this PR only rewrites R S1-5.14 and R S1-5.15. Checked locally on top of #370: `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `RulesCoverageTest` and `AveragePriceSearchTest` (19 tests, 91 assertions, OK). Shane closes the original.
params.title: The average-price search counts on every select, and the calculation is pinned (restacked)
